author: master-designer
status: PROPOSAL for user approval. Does not change any binding document. The living room (B, v4.1) is fixed and is reproduced here unchanged. Every new camera, station and clearance is a pinhole estimate; motion-agent verifies it in a house blockout (0 credits) before any credit.

conventions.axes: Same world as v4-spec.json: metres, origin on the living-room floor at its back wall, X right as the living master camera sees it, Y from the living back wall toward the camera/entrance, Z up. All rectangles are INTERIOR wall faces.
conventions.compass: Living window wall faces north (v4-spec 'North-facing'). Therefore: north = -X, south = +X, east = -Y, west = +Y. Plan drawing: draw -Y (east) up and -X (north) left; then the living room is top-left and the house extends down the page to the west.
conventions.yaw_deg_left: As v4-spec: heading measured from -Y, positive = turned toward -X (north). f = (-sin yaw, -cos yaw). yaw 25 = M0. yaw 0 = looking east. yaw -35 = looking 35 deg toward the south (+X).
conventions.projection: Use the v4-spec 24 mm equations relative to each camera: d = f.(P-C), x = r.(P-C) with r = (cos yaw, -sin yaw); u = u0 + 0.6667 x/d; v = v0 + 1.1852 (1.20 - Z)/d. Horizontal half-field about +-36 deg.
conventions.walls: Interior partitions 0.15. Mamad (protected room) walls 0.30. Exterior walls 0.35 (= living window frame plane at X -2.65).
conventions.sun: Render time is the Bible 1.4 time for the whole house: 15:00, mid-winter. At 15:00 in December in central Israel the sun is about SW (azimuth ~220, altitude ~25). Only north (-X) and east (-Y) facades are in shade then, so every window that is seen in, or lights, a master frame is on the north or east facade. South/west facades have no window seen in any frame (kitchen south wall, master west wall: solid).
conventions.transition_grammar: As motion-direction 2.3: every shot is one straight move (dolly/slider/pedestal merged into one vector, constant heading) or a pan-only shot from a fixed point. Room-to-room transition = chain of such shots. New in this plan (user decision U4/U5): 'pull-back' (a backward dolly used as a forward transition) and 60 deg turns split into two 30 deg pan shots.
